description:
## Question

For each open ticket, one question: does it block the 0.1.0 release? (Decided on the map 'Wayfinder: defk ready for a first Hex release': no full re-priority.)

Scope: the deferred epics (defk-52v, defk-n4r, defk-sve, defk-ulk, defk-96f) and the expansion candidates in docs/verdict.md ('Where defk could grow'), and the children of the support epics (defk-9p6, defk-djy, defk-o08, defk-vcx, defk-w8r). The agent prepares a table of every open ticket with a proposed yes or no and a reason; the maintainer decides each row.

Input from the map: new constructs are allowed under the stability promise, so no expansion candidate must land before 0.1.0 only to protect the promise. Precompiled artefacts (defk-ajw) are not a gate.

Done when: every row has a decision; 'yes' rows become tickets under the map (or are linked as blockers of the release-readiness check); 'no' rows stay where they are, unchanged.

comments.text:
Resolution (grilling, 2026-10-14). Rule: a ticket blocks 0.1.0 only if it is a bug, changes something 0.1.0 freezes (the stability promise), or would leave the first release wrong. No bug ticket was open.

Blocks 0.1.0 (wired to defk-wfi.6):
- defk-djy.19 HexDocs pages must not reference ADRs or tickets (the extras are the release's public face; performance.md and scope.md still carry ticket ids) (Q1).
- defk-wfi.12 Note in the language reference: lint checks may flag length/1 in a kernel (new, from the renames; the maintainer chose to block on it) (Q4 a).

Does not block (Q2, Q3): every other open ticket. Speed only: defk-o08 and u1u, qdz, b38, pvt, pic, siy, 9za, n7k, fun; agp, 5qk, i5r, oed, w8l, 25s, cao, c1e, wnu. Additive constructs: oit, sbp, nii, pe3, 3rl, defk-vcx. Error/report quality (texts and facts not promised): ajj, xyz, 27w, 10d (later, keeping CompileError). Unstable API: 9qv. Additive docs: djy.17, djy.18, vcx.1, defk-djy after djy.19. Catalog/measurement: defk-9p6, 9p6.21, 9p6.29, 9p6.30, 9p6.31, l2g, 7tk, vcx.2, defk-w8r. Deferred epics stay deferred, for planning after 0.1.0: defk-n4r, defk-52v, defk-sve, defk-ulk, defk-96f, defk-ajw (already not a gate), defk-o1w.

title: Triage: which open tickets block 0.1.0
